name: Intelligent Tools

sources.title: Homepage — 600+ tools across 18 categories, active newest-additions feed
Submit page — Free listing ($0, reviewed within 7 days) and Featured ($19/mo or $189/yr) forms with full field list

requirements: AI tools / software tools across 18 categories (AI Agents, Code Generation, Image, Video, Writing, Productivity, etc.)
Free form fields: Tool Name, Website URL, Tagline (max 100 chars), Description (min 100 chars), Category, Pricing Model (Free/Freemium/Paid Only/Open Source), Your Email
No account and no card required for the free listing
Manual review — 'reviewed by hand' within 7 days; accuracy agreement on submit
preparation: Pricing model classification and contact email
workflow: Fill the 'Submit your free listing' form (name, URL, tagline, description, category, pricing model, email)
Submit Tool for Review — notification arrives by email once the listing is live
Optional: use the Featured form ($19/month or $189/year via PayPal/card) for a verified badge, priority placement, and 24-hour turnaround
watchFor: Featured is a recurring subscription, not one-time — cancel by emailing boki@intelligenttools.co
Free tier is a 'basic tool profile' — featured section contains affiliate links, so placement quality differs
Tagline is capped at 100 chars and description has a 100-char minimum — write to the limits
Upgrade path is manual (email) — no self-serve upgrade button
countsAsLive: Confirmation email arrives and the tool page appears under intelligenttools.co/tools and its category page
unknowns: Whether free listing links are dofollow
Rejection criteria beyond accuracy — no published editorial bar
Actual review time within the stated 7-day window
